evidence.title: GitHub - mattpocock/skills: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

name: Skills For Real Engineers
summary: Collection of small, composable agent skills for everyday engineering work, taken straight from Matt Pocock's .agents directory.
description: Agent skills for real engineering rather than vibe coding, split into user-invoked skills that orchestrate (grill-with-docs, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, implement, wayfinder, retro, improve-codebase-architecture) and model-invoked skills that hold the discipline (tdd, diagnosing-bugs, code-review, codebase-design, domain-modeling, wizard), plus productivity skills (grill-me, handoff, teach). Installs as a plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI, or via npx skills for any other agent; setup-matt-pocock-skills configures tracker, labels and docs per repo.
contains: engineering and productivity skills shipped as SKILL.md packages
install: plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code, or npx skills for any other agent
run /setup-matt-pocock-skills once per repo: issue tracker, triage labels, docs location
user-invoked skills orchestrate work; model-invoked skills are reachable automatically or by name
engineering core: to-spec, to-tickets, implement, tdd, diagnosing-bugs, code-review
architecture and diagnosis: improve-codebase-architecture, wayfinder, retro, research
productivity: grill-me, grill-with-docs, handoff, teach, to-questionnaire, wait-what
skills stay small, easy to adapt and composable; work with any model
